cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails with the rest-key hint; the rest key named before they start

rubric.reason: Before the learner started, Turn 2 named the rest pose and time ('it's full size and level at 4.3 s… put the playhead at 4.3 s before you start'). After the check returned set_away_from_rest, Turn 3 said Pop 'is still shrunk' at 3.3 s and to put the playhead on 4.3 s.

Turn 3 says what is off and where, with real names and times ('the playhead was at 3.3 s when you set it, and Pop is still shrunk there'), points to Edit > Undo and the rest key, and leaves the redo to the learner without doing it or offering to.

Every name and time is backed by tool output or the record: Wobble and Seal with their reasons, Pop, 'center' and 'bottom-middle' from place_now, 4.3 s from check_times, 3.3 s from anchor_check, and Title from the record 'two weeks ago' (2026-10-12).
